params.caption: 🏆 PGL moves its 2027 CS2 stop from China to Mongolia PGL has relocated one of its 2027 Counter-Strike events: instead of China, the circuit will now stop in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, in April. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 14:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: HLTV #CS2 #PGL #GamingNews
